4863-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4863-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4247-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4247-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1010-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3174-3899-5571--6.description:
Use Switcheroo to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

277-2557-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-2557-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-5434-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2457-4321-5794-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens and two Food tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-6627-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Doc Samson.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

4875-5256-5659-6482.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Avenging Angel.
When Avenging Angel dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Avenging Angel's power, which will cause you to mill Avenging Angel.
As Avenging Angel is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Avenging Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1451-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Pyreheart Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
1451-2921-6972.notes: If Pyreheart Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1510-4574-4779-5849.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

2366-5175-5295-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5175-5295-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-6159-6754.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6159-6754.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

944-2342-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

3532-3949-4908-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

625-1597-1978.description:
Cause Gyre Sage to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat from step 2.

6103-6105-6798.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4.
Repeat from 3.

49-2034-6351-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Teval triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.
49-2034-6351-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

2843-2921-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2843-2921-6553.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1329-2707-4377-6504.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1329-2707-4377-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Conjurer's Bauble. Then, cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Walk the Aeons onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

862-2538-3139-3676.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, causing you to return Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2097-2316-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2097-2316-4871.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

437-509-2751-4131-5517.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-2751-4131-5517.notablePrerequisites: Sphinx's Disciple has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
437-509-2751-4131-5517.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Sphinx's Disciple to become an artifact.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

3221-3283-4114.description:
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers, holding priority, activate The Beamtown Bullies by tapping it, causing the opponent to put Notion Thief from your graveyard onto the battlefield under their control.
Resolve the Consecrated Sphinx trigger, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-4068.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
2155-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Mystic Barrier

3790-4948.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
3790-4948.description:
At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, Mystic Barrier and Estrid's Invocation trigger, choosing "left" for Mystic Barrier and "right" for Estrid's Invocation.
As long as there are three or more players in the game, creatures cannot attack.

498-1399-3814.notablePrerequisites:
Elvish Guidance attached to any other mana-producing land you control.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
498-1399-3814.description:
Activate the land with Elvish Guidance attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Elvish Guidance triggers, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the land with Elvish Guidance attached and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat.
If you control at least one additional Elf, this combo nets infinite green mana, and you may tap other lands for mana.
